study: TSM SSv2 six-recipe sparse-supervised temporal transfer study
scope: Training-only exploratory OOF recipe/threshold selection; not independent accuracy
method: Official eight-segment TSM ResNet50 SSv2 encoder. Two fixed full-width upper/lower 60% portrait tiles, each RGB 224-square with ImageNet normalization. Top/bottom raw 174-class logits concatenate to 348 features; independently unit-normalized 2048-D vectors concatenate to 4096. Each representation uses C=.01/.1/1. New weighted StandardScaler and logistic regression fit within each unique-content fold; whole-clip score is the linear 90th percentile of all context probabilities.
fitting_scope: Normal fitting groups supply all contexts as negatives. Positive fitting groups supply only logical contexts containing sparse annotations; unannotated positive contexts remain unknown. Class and clip sample weights are used once in both scaler and classifier. Held-out scoring uses all contexts without annotations.
training_gate_rule: Rank training OOF standardized partial AUC at FPR<=.25, then full ROC-AUC, then declared order. The selected candidate must have ROC-AUC>.6, partial AUC>.5 and an OOF threshold with specificity>=.8, recall>=.5, balanced accuracy>=.65.

public_model_provenance.integrity_scope: Actual locally computed download SHA256 and byte count from official HTTPS; no author-published weight digest was found

pre_source_sampling_amendment.description: Initial dense 73-context synthetic hardware qualification failed. Before any source processing, v2 fixed non-overlapping four-second contexts with starts 0,4,... and at most 37 contexts. Eight targets are sampled at 2 FPS; short tails repeat the last authentic frame and its actual PTS.
pre_source_sampling_amendment.scope: Synthetic local hardware choice before case inference; no quality or host/service latency qualification

extraction.scope: Observed local feature extraction only; not cold full-engine, HTTP, queue, or target-host service qualification
extraction.frame_count_limit: The final aggregate does not establish unique/authentic frame or padding totals; no such totals are inferred.

technical_checks.scope: Technical checks only, separate from application tests and task accuracy

limitations: The same 24 development groups support exploratory training OOF comparisons. Neither selection8 nor test8 was processed by this study; the historical test was already exposed by the baseline.
Sparse annotation eligibility is weak supervision; it does not establish complete intervals, action types, event localization, authorization, intent, identity, or legal obligations.
2 FPS sampling may miss brief actions, padded contexts repeat observations, and q90 may miss a single brief event in a long clip.
Passing a training gate, if observed, would not establish independent generalization or permit promotion.
Checkpoint terms remain unconfirmed. This is private local research; weights are not redistributed and no serving promotion is authorized.

The receiving party will run the package on its own infrastructure. Docker, target hardware/runtime, offline execution and the full HTTP/queue/cold-start path there remain unqualified. Local feature extraction timing does not qualify that host.
